title: Building more helpful ChatGPT experiences for everyone
summary: We’re partnering with experts, strengthening protections for teens with parental controls, and routing sensitive conversations to reasoning models in ChatGPT.
body: We’re partnering with experts, strengthening protections for teens with parental controls, and routing sensitive conversations to reasoning models in ChatGPT.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布改进ChatGPT体验，包括与专家合作加强青少年保护、推出家长控制功能，以及在处理敏感对话时自动将其路由至推理模型，以提升对话的帮助性和安全性。原始信息显示：We’re partnering with experts, strengthening protections for teens with parental controls, and routing sensitive conversations to reasoning models in ChatGPT.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Building more helpful ChatGPT experiences for everyone”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI宣布为ChatGPT推出强化青少年保护、家长控制及将敏感对话路由至推理模型的功能。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
